shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -R .agents/skills/gravity-ui | head -80 && echo ---- && cat AGENTS.md && echo ---- && cat package.json && ls

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && rg -n -C 3 -i 'navigation|@gravity-ui/table|app shell|data grid|aside' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120 && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat {}' && echo ---- && cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && ls __agent_eval__ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

sed -n 452,480p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md | head -60 && echo ---- && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"' && grep -n 'icons' package-lock.json | head -5 && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -40
npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -30; echo ----; npm view @gravity-ui/table version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -30

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @gravity-ui/i18n lodash 2>&1 | tail -15 && npm install -D @types/lodash 2>&1 | tail -3 && grep -A14 '"dependencies"' package.json

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader PageLayout MenuItem; echo ----; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table Table useTable ColumnReorderingProvider selectionColumn; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build 2>/dev/null

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader PageLayout MenuItem; echo ----; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table Table useTable ColumnReorderingProvider selectionColumn; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md
sed -n 1,200p /home/node/.claude/projects/-home-sandbox-workspace/770c7990-c458-43b6-a606-b79dcc29931a/tool-results/bbdvzq3ln.txt | tail -175
sed -n 200,520p /home/node/.claude/projects/-home-sandbox-workspace/770c7990-c458-43b6-a606-b79dcc29931a/tool-results/bbdvzq3ln.txt

sed -n 520,760p /home/node/.claude/projects/-home-sandbox-workspace/770c7990-c458-43b6-a606-b79dcc29931a/tool-results/bbdvzq3ln.txt; echo ---- DOCS; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/* | head -40

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table; rg -n -C 6 'useRowSelectionFixedHandler' $T/build/docs/INDEX.md $T/build/esm/index.d.ts $T/build/esm/hooks/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ---- FIXED; find $T/build/esm -name 'useRowSelectionFixedHandler*.d.ts' -exec cat {} \;; echo ---- TABLEPROPS; find $T/build/esm -path '*Table/Table.d.ts' -o -path '*BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts' | head; cat $T/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo; echo ---- BASEPROPS; sed -n 1,140p $T/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---- TREE; cat $T/build/esm/components/TreeExpandableCell/TreeExpandableCell.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---- COLMETA; rg -n 'withNestingStyles|showTreeDepthIndicators|enableColumnReordering|hideInSettings' $T/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -20; echo ---- STYLES; ls $T/build/esm/*.css $T/build/esm/**/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -3; rg -n -i 'styles|\.css|required setup' $T/README.md | head -10

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation; T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table; echo ---- ASIDE DOC; sed -n 1,140p $N/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; echo ---- ASIDE TYPES; find $N/build/esm -path '*AsideHeader/types.d.ts' -exec sed -n 1,140p {} \;; echo ---- MENUITEM; rg -n -A 30 'export (interface|type) MenuItem\b' $N/build/esm/types.d.ts | head -60; echo ---- LOGO; rg -n -A 20 'export (interface|type) LogoProps' $N/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -30; echo ---- ICONS; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | rg -x '(House|Persons|Person|ShoppingCart|Gear|Cart|Box|Receipt|Magnifier|Bell|Plus|ArrowDownToLine|CircleQuestion|ListUl|Clock|TrashBin|Pencil|ArrowsRotateRight|Ellipsis|Funnel|Xmark|Check|CircleCheck|CircleXmark|Truck|BoxOpen|Cube|FileText|Rocket|LayoutHeaderSidebar)\.js' | sort; echo ---- TABLESIZE; cat $T/build/esm/components/Table/types.d.ts; echo ---- ROWPROPS; rg -n 'getGroupTitle|getIsGroupHeaderRow|onClick|className\?' $T/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts | head; echo ---- SETTINGS; rg -n -A 12 'getSettingsColumn' $T/build/esm/constants/*.d.ts | head -40; echo ---- UIKIT; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -3; rg -n '^\s*(theme|size|view)\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation; T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table; echo ---- MENUITEM; rg -n -B2 -A 32 'export interface MenuItem\b' $N/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -70; echo ---- RENDERCONTENT; rg -n 'RenderContentType' $N/build/esm/components/Content/*.d.ts | head -5; echo ---- GROUPHEADER DEFAULT; rg -n -B2 -A6 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' $T/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | head -40; echo ---- SELECTED CSS; rg -n 'selected|_interactive' $T/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css $T/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | head -12; echo ---- SELCOL; cat $T/build/esm/constants/selectionColumn.d.ts; echo ---- UIKIT INDEX; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -3; rg -n '^export \{' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | rg -o "'\./(Text|Flex|Label|Button|Icon|TextInput|Select|Card|Switch|Checkbox|Box)'" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo ---- SWITCH; rg -n 'checked\?|onUpdate\?|content\?|size\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -8; echo ---- TEXTINPUT; rg -n 'startContent|onUpdate|hasClear|placeholder' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts | head -8

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table; rg -n -B3 -A8 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' $T/build/esm/components/BaseRow/hooks/*.js $T/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/*.js $T/build/esm/components/BaseRow/*.js 2>/dev/null | rg -v '^\S+-\s*$' | head -50; echo ---- CONTROLPROPS; rg -n 'onUpdate|checked\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -5

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table; rg -n -A6 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' $T/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | head -30; echo ---- GROUPHEADER; find $T/build/esm/components -name 'BaseGroupHeader*.d.ts' -exec cat {} \; | head -30
sed -n 1,30p node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/base.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n 'enableColumnReordering' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm --glob '*.js' | head -5

sed -i "s#import { ColumnReorderingProvider, Table, selectionColumn, useRowSelectionFixedHandler, useTable } from '@gravity-ui/table';#import { ColumnReorderingProvider, Table, selectionColumn, useRowSelectionFixedHandler, useTable } from '@gravity-ui/table';\nimport type { ColumnDef } from '@gravity-ui/table';#; s#import type { ColumnDef, ExpandedState, Row, RowSelectionState, SortingState } from '@gravity-ui/table/tanstack';#import type { ExpandedState, Row, RowSelectionState, SortingState } from '@gravity-ui/table/tanstack';#" src/components/OrdersTable.tsx && sed -n 1,5p src/components/OrdersTable.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && echo TSC_OK && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -12

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js; echo ----; rg -n -A4 '^\.gn-aside-header \{' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -12; echo ----; git status --short

rm -rf dist && rg -n -m3 'height' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -5; rg -n -m2 'gn-aside-header__pane-container|gn-aside-header_' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -3

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components; cat $N/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | tr '}' '}\n' | rg 'pane-container|__content|__pane\b' | head -8; echo ---- CONTENT; cat $N/Content/Content.css 2>/dev/null | tr '}' '}\n' | head -10; cat $N/Content/Content.js | head -40
